title: Stream transcript (invalid): SESSION_CONTROL entry with reserved opcode 0x08
description: Serialized SAR stream transcript with SESSION_INIT followed by a SESSION_CONTROL entry using opcode 0x08. Session opcodes 0x08..=0x0F are reserved per spec and must be rejected. Must be rejected with SAR_ERR_RESERVED_VALUE.
notes: This is a serialized SAR stream transcript, not an ordinary static archive.
Session opcodes 0x08..=0x0F are reserved; receivers must fail closed.
Additional QUIC control streams are not covered here (future transport-vector work).
